d: We are seeking technically skilled and results-oriented professionals for the positions of Project Engineer / Senior Engineer. These roles focus on engineering project planning, technical coordination, design evaluation, project execution, and the delivery of efficient engineering solutions. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong engineering knowledge, analytical thinking, leadership abilities, and an understanding of project management principles, technical standards, and operational requirements.

Responsibilities include coordinating engineering projects, reviewing technical specifications, evaluating design proposals, and ensuring that project activities are completed according to established objectives and quality requirements. Professionals will work with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, suppliers, and stakeholders to coordinate project schedules, allocate technical resources, monitor project progress, and resolve engineering challenges. Additional duties include preparing technical reports, reviewing engineering drawings, conducting site inspections, evaluating project risks, monitoring budgets and resource utilization, and ensuring compliance with applicable safety and engineering standards. They will also support technical decision-making, implement corrective actions, assess project performance, and contribute to process improvements. Senior-level responsibilities may include providing technical guidance, overseeing engineering activities, coordinating complex project requirements, and supporting strategic project planning.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related technical discipline.
Strong understanding of engineering principles, project coordination, and technical execution.
Knowledge of engineering design, technical specifications, and project documentation.
Familiarity with project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.
Ability to evaluate technical challenges and recommend practical engineering solutions.
Understanding of quality assurance, risk management, and workplace safety requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software, and relevant engineering tools.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder coordination skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality, project efficiency, and continuous improvement.
Budget control: OPEX and/or CAPEX and/or Revenue amount as relevant

Lead and manage refinery engineering, capital projects, modifications, and technical assurance activities to ensure safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operation of refinery assets. Oversee the full project lifecycle from concept development and feasibility studies through design, execution, commissioning, and handover while ensuring compliance with applicable engineering standards, regulatory requirements, and refinery business objectives.

The position will act in accordance with OQ8’s Mission, Vision, Values & Strategies, as well as policies, guidelines and international standards, supported by an IT technology platform, HSE standards, Oman’s government and other legal requirements, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Industrial, or Process Engineering or a related discipline.
Excellent knowledge of reading, written and spoken English (required).

Relevant experience in Engineering, Projects & Technical Services in a similar role or leadership role within Oil & Gas (refining, petrochemical, oil & gas, LNG, or other complex hydrocarbon processing industries).

Proven track record in delivering brownfield projects, plant modifications, debottlenecking initiatives, capacity expansion projects, technology upgrades, and capital investment programs from concept through commissioning and handover.
Extensive experience in engineering design review, technical assurance, process optimization, operational troubleshooting, and Management of Change (MOC) within a refinery environment.

Demonstrated success in managing CAPEX portfolios, project budgets, schedules, resources, contractors, and engineering consultants, ensuring delivery of projects within approved cost, quality, and timeline objectives.

Strong experience supporting refinery operations through technical studies, feasibility assessments, root cause investigations, performance improvement initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
Practical knowledge of FEED, detailed engineering, EPC/EPCM project execution models, commissioning, start-up, and performance testing of refinery facilities and infrastructure.
Experience in applying relevant international engineering standards and industry codes, including API, ASME, NFPA, IEC, ISA, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, manage cross-functional teams, and build effective relationships with technology licensors, contractors, regulatory authorities, and external service providers.

Experience leading organizational improvement initiatives, fostering innovation, developing engineering talent, and implementing best practices that enhance refinery safety, reliability, efficiency, and business performance.
Engineering Standards & Codes (API, ASME, ASTM, IEC, NFPA)
r: Lead refinery engineering activities covering process, mechanical, piping, civil, structural, electrical, instrumentation, automation, and reliability engineering disciplines.

Develop and execute CAPEX projects, brownfield modifications, plant upgrades, debottlenecking projects, reliability improvement initiatives, and strategic investment programs.

Monitor project performance through KPIs, progress reporting, forecasting, and project governance processes.

Drive technology adoption, digitalization, process optimization, and innovation initiatives.

Develop and manage engineering and project budgets, CAPEX plans, and long-term investment programs.
Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary engineering and project teams.
Foster a culture of safety, innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Internal: OMT, HSSE, SCM, Finance, Turnaround Teams, Executive Leadership Team, Information Technology / Digital Teams.

External: EPC Contractors, Engineering Consultants, Technology Licensors, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), Regulatory Authorities, Utility Providers, Industry Associations and Technical Networks.
